2125286278698762405.en_summary: $BKKT I don’t recall ever seeing this stock with an RSI at 19 and trading at just 0.13x sales. Today’s sell-off came on relatively low volume compared with recent sessions. It’s a heavily shorted name, and there has been no meaningful insider selling (or buying) since August, when Michael Alfred @mikealfred bought 296,567 shares at $7.12. I’m not sure if accumulating here is the right move, but i did, bc at these levels the risk/reward looks attractive to me.
